content.title: Baseball Route Closure | Hit, Fielding, Umpire Signal and Home Slide
content.summary: An adult baseball runner links one hit, fielding response and home-plate slide. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult player and jersey persist. + The same ball links hit and fielding. + Base geography remains readable. + Exactly one slide completes the route. + Celebration follows arrival without inventing a score.
quick_start.recommended_input: One clearly adult animated batter in jersey eleven hits one ball at home plate. An outfielder fields the same ball as a high view keeps runner, bases and throwing lane visible. Complete one feet-first slide into home, then let her stand and raise both arms while teammates visibly react; do not show a score.
